name: prompt-master
description: A standalone prompt-engineering system that interprets requests, preserves requirements, and produces precise, executable prompts and task briefs.

interface.longDescription: Interpret user intent, preserve constraints and exclusions, structure requirements, resolve material ambiguity, and produce clear prompts or execution briefs for AI assistants, agents, tools, developers, or human operators. Operates independently of any larger toolkit.
defaultPrompt: Engineer a precise prompt for this task.
Turn these requirements into a self-contained execution brief.
Review and improve this prompt without changing its intent.
